authority: BIB-0027 (user ruling 2026-09-22): cultivation.json SUP-002, SUP-010, XA-magic-02; world.json WR-002, WR-010; h1_summary.md §6
bible_write_path: Written in place under the BIB-0027 change request; memory-bible collects them through on_bible_access. IDs and top-level structure are unchanged, and dialogue and events are untouched.

shared_conventions.rendering_block: Each card gains a 'rendering' object (mode, rule, species, limits) and a 'revision' stamp. The machine-check keys hair / eyes / build / marks / base_age_range / default_outfit_tone are kept: 'hair' now describes the coat (fur, feathers, scales or shell).
shared_conventions.base_age_range: Kept as the persona age for voice casting; each card's note gives the animal's life stage.
shared_conventions.scale: Species-true sizes. The text's relative-size beats come from Alice's SUP-003 scale. Dream-scale exceptions: the two Footmen, sized to the four-foot house, and the Gryphon and Mock Turtle.
shared_conventions.props: Only text-given or text-implied props are kept. All invented period clothing from the human-performer reading is dropped.
shared_conventions.removed_wording: performer_coding / sup002_coding / performer_basis blocks with 'human performer', 'no CGI' and 'no prosthetic' limits; prompts ending 'realistic period drama, human actor(s)'. Every prompt_base_en / prompt_summary_en is rewritten as a photoreal CGI animal in a live-action plate.

changed_files.note: Small albino white rabbit (pink eyes echo CRE-001), 26-30 cm sitting up, so the tiptoe-to-ear beat of ch008 works. Wears only the checked waistcoat and watch; gloves, fan, reading spectacles (tint dropped), and the trial trumpet, scroll and tabard.
Old grey-brown house mouse, natural size, wet and bristling; his real long tail replaces the coat-tail; no clothing.
Scientifically reconstructed dodo, 65-75 cm; Shakespeare pose done with a wing-tip; thimble held in the beak; no clothing.
Mallard drake; sleek waterproof plumage sets him apart among the draggled party; no clothing.
Red lory parrot, scarlet with blue; perched at Alice's face height for the argument; no clothing.
Half-downy golden-eagle chick, about 6-7 weeks, 40-48 cm; eye colour corrected to dark brown for the life stage; no clothing.
Old Eurasian magpie with frayed tail; the one prop is a dark grey muffler implied by 'wrapping itself up'.
Clear yellow hen canary; her unregistered chicks are background CGI fledglings.
All six slots are CGI animals, none human: moorhen, coot, water vole, wren, grey heron, sand martin. Species-true sizes, soaked state kept.
Blue hawk-moth-type larva, three inches reared, matching three-inch Alice. True legs folded ('arms folded'); hookah and mushroom kept. Now consistent with style reference alice.jpeg.
Common lizard, natural size, soot-dusted; real tail waves when he is put in head-down; tiny slate at the trial; jersey and scarf dropped.
Wood pigeon, ruffled from sleeplessness; beats Alice with its wings; nest with two eggs; dress and bonnet dropped.
Large brown classic tabby, green-gold eyes, long claws, real tail for the tail-first vanish (SUP-005). Grin is the one anatomical departure (pending_H2). Dinah echo is now the same animal look.
Wild brown hare with straw in its fur; sits up at the table beside the human Hatter; handles watch and butter knife with forepaws.
Hazel dormouse at natural size, so the elbow-cushion and teapot beats work literally; curled asleep.
Photoreal classical griffin (golden-eagle front, lion rear), 150-165 cm sitting; eagle forelegs are the text's 'paws'; labourer's dress and mantle dropped.
Photoreal turtle body with calf head, hooves and tail, sitting upright on the ledge; flippers used as hands; eyes corrected to calf dark brown; invented handkerchief dropped.
Large old edible crab, rust-brown and barnacled; cap and claw mitts dropped; pair rule rewritten as the same species, older and duller.
Young edible crab, bright coral and clean-shelled; snood and mitts dropped.
CGI common frog at dream size (75-85 cm) in snuff-brown Duchess livery and powdered curled wig. Magnifying spectacles and shoes dropped. Anatomy options A/B/C, pending_H2.
CGI cod-headed figure (80-90 cm, matched to the Frog-Footman) in crimson Hearts livery and powdered wig; silver scale facings dropped. Anatomy options A/B/C, pending_H2.
All 11 jurors are CGI animals, none human (6 animals, 5 birds, species listed per slot). Court humans stay SUP-004. Slates sized to the animals; guinea-pig sack beat kept gentle.
All 10 crowd slots are CGI animals, none human; Pat (human, own card) is on location. Heavy ladder and barrow staging proposal pending_H2.
Infant stage unchanged. New stages block: slide (CGI drift option A vs handover option B) and pig end-state as a photoreal CGI piglet, both pending_H2; prompt_pig_en added.

defects_opened.note: Non-blocking H2 routing of the pending_H2 items (Footmen anatomy, pig-baby slide and end-state, Cheshire grin, crowd heavy-prop staging) and two design conventions (scale, props-only).
